description: Approves the story MusVideo proposed for a project (optionally with the user's notes) and starts building the storyboard of scenes. No extra credits: the story fee was charged by create_mv_project. Only call after the user has seen the story and said it is fine. Takes a few minutes; then call get_mv_progress.

feedback.description: Optional changes the user asked for.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

name: approve_story
title: Approve the story
